  "key_numbers": [
    "Overall engraftment rate was 73.8% (31/42).",
    "Histopathological consistency between primary tumours and tumour grafts was 100%.",
    "PDTX predictions showed a 100% correspondence to clinical outcomes for 17 regimens.",
    "Average outgrowth time of 31 PDTX was 57.5 days.",
    "TP53 and KMT2C were the most frequently altered genes in sequenced tumours.",
    "The combination of docetaxel and gemcitabine showed a response rate of 9/12 in PDTX testing.",
    "Paclitaxel showed a response rate of 7/12 in PDTX testing.",
    "Apatinib had the worst response rate in PDTX testing, with only one patient responding.",
    "42 patients enrolled (36 bone sarcomas, 6 soft-tissue sarcomas).",
    "Median patient age was 21 years (range 10-66)."
